$comment: Share images and social posts. Layouts and opening copy follow the brand's image tool in agd-playground (src/components/opencommerce-og/draw.ts and Editor.tsx, routes opencommerce-og-image-playground and opencommerce-social-post). The four layouts there are hero, window, closing and cards; the CLI keeps its earlier five (headline, lead, frame, quote, announcement) beside them. Sizes, safe areas, text floors and upload limits are the shared ones in src/design/platforms.ts. Colors, radii, shadows, faces, tracking and line heights come from brand/tokens.css; where the tool's literals disagree, the token wins (see notes). Pixel sizes are the tool's, in the 1200x630 preview's pixels, grown with the image's area (unit k).

hero.description: The badge, the headline and its line centered, optional keys, and a window under them with the glyph field in the margins either side. Code is always whole; a picture too tall for the room left rises from the bottom edge and fades into the ground. With no --code or --image the window is left out.

sample.headline: Open router for commerce
sample.body: Buy from any online store from a single endpoint.
sample.label: agent.ts

window.description: The words on one side and the window on the other with the glyph field round it; stacked on a tall image. The window takes --code or --image and is sized to it.

sample.headline: Built for agents that buy
sample.label: agent.ts

closing.description: A mist card with 16px corners and a hairline edge, the glyph field gathering at its edges, the lockup, words and keys centered.

sample.headline: Give your agent a checkout
sample.body: One endpoint, every online store. Start free, and your first purchase can go through today.

cards.description: Numbered cards: a title across the top, window-white cards with the blue number, the glyph field round the edges, and a footer with the lockup and the address.

sample.headline: Built for agents that buy
sample.cards:

headline.description: A headline, with an optional badge line above it.

lead.description: A headline and a short supporting line.

sample.headline: Open router for commerce
sample.body: One endpoint for agents to search, check out and track orders.

frame.description: A product window: --image for a screenshot (shown whole), --code for code, or --body for copy inside it. --headline sits above.

sample.headline: Watch it in action
sample.label: agent.ts

quote.description: A quotation (--body), with an optional attribution.

sample.body: The checkout is one request, and the order comes back as data.

announcement.description: A badge line, a headline and an optional flat key.

sample.headline: Agents can buy from any store

avatar.description: A profile picture: the mark, its blue carried to the edges so a circle crop never cuts it. --inset sets the whole mark on the ground instead.
avatar.source: brand/logo/mark.svg; the edge is the sticker rule in brand/assets/merch.json (the mark carried past the cut)

notes: Line heights: the tool sets headlines at 1.04 and the line under them at 1.5; the tokens say --ds-leading-heading 1.02 and --ds-leading-lead 1.55, and the CLI uses the tokens.

Window drop: the tool's canvas shadow is rgba(23,24,24,0.22) with a 32px blur and no spread; the CLI draws --ds-shadow-card (a hairline drop and 0 12px 32px -20px at 22 percent), so the drop is tighter than the tool's.
Headline weight: the tool sets the display face at 500; the CLI outlines the bundled substitute (TeX Gyre Heros, one weight), since Neue Haas Grotesk Display is not licensed to ship.
Attribution chip: the tool draws Agentcard's own lockup after 'Product by'. That lockup is not a file in brand/logo, so the CLI typesets the maker's name in the display face instead.
Merchants: the tool can fill the window with sixteen store logos (public/opencommerce-og). Those are third-party marks and are not shipped; the window takes code or your own --image.
Lockup: the tool follows the name with 'Product by' and Agentcard's lockup; the CLI uses brand/logo/lockup.svg (the name and 'by Agentcard').
The window arrow is typed in the platform mono; the bundled mono has no such glyph, so it is drawn from Inter.
Hero window: the tool runs the window off the bottom edge and cuts it. The CLI draws code whole, and fades a picture window that leaves the canvas.
Opening copy: the tool opens with its own chip, headline and code. The CLI draws only the copy it is given; --sample fills the sample copy.
Comments in code: the site's faint ink (2.7:1 on white) fails for text this small, so images set them in --ds-color-text-secondary on white and --ds-color-text-faint on the dark window.
Logo clear space and smallest size: brand/ has no printed rule, so they are the site header's own (see logo).

logo.source: The site header sets the name at 17px and pads its tray 9px round it (registry site-header: pt-2.25): no smaller, and no closer.
